interface.longDescription: Turn a brand name, industry and style brief into AI logo concepts with ManyMotions (formerly ClipWave). Logo Maker prepares the logo prompt and settings, generates up to four concepts per request in your connected ManyMotions account (GPT Image 2 by default, other image models available), lets you check the job status in chat and opens the result in the Media Forge Logo tab to refine, re-run or download. Generating uses credits in your existing ManyMotions account. Outputs are AI-generated raster PNG images; editable vector files and trademark clearance are not included.
defaultPrompt: Create four minimalist logo concepts for Northline, an outdoor clothing brand, using forest green and white.
Design a bold wordmark logo for Dawn, a specialty coffee shop.
Make geometric monogram logo concepts for Vela, a software company.

positive.description: Prepare a minimalist outdoor brand logo project
positive.prompt: Prepare a project for four minimalist logo concepts for Northline, an outdoor clothing brand, using forest green and white. Show me the settings and current credit cost; do not generate yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a logo project with the brief, default logo model GPT Image 2, ratio 1:1 and count 4, then shows the settings, the credit cost returned by the tool and the Media Forge link. No generation or charge yet.

positive.description: Generate the prepared logo project on explicit request (continue case 1 with the same linked account)
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one Media Forge image job for the prepared project in the connected account, charges the shown credits once, returns the job id and status; polling returns completed image URLs (up to 4) and the Media Forge project link. Missing paid access returns an explanatory error without checkout links.

positive.description: Generate two wordmark concepts for a coffee brand
positive.prompt: Design a bold wordmark logo for Dawn, a specialty coffee shop, black and cream, and generate two options.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares the project with count 2 and the requested colors in the prompt, generates after the explicit request, returns two raster logo images from the same job. Does not start a video and does not touch other projects.

positive.description: Edit settings before generating (continue a prepared project in the same account)
positive.prompt: Make it a square 2K logo instead, then generate.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates ratio/resolution of the prepared project, shows the new credit cost, then generates once. A changed setting clears the previous job so the new generation reflects the edit.

positive.description: Check the status of the last logo job (continue a preceding generated project)
positive.prompt: Check the status of the logo generation we just started and show the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the owner's job status and, when complete, the image URLs and the Media Forge link. Never starts another generation and never exposes another user's job.

negative.description: Video creation is outside this logo-only plugin. Do not call Logo Maker tools.
negative.prompt: Create a ten-second cinematic video of a car driving through a city.

negative.description: Editing uploaded files and producing editable SVG are unsupported. Do not invoke Logo Maker or another paid generator; explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Here is my current logo PNG, remove the background and turn it into an editable SVG.

negative.description: Trademark registration and legal clearance are not provided. Do not call Logo Maker tools or claim the mark is legally available.
negative.prompt: Register my logo as a trademark and guarantee that no other company owns it.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Generation consumes credits in the existing linked ManyMotions account; no checkout or upgrade flow is provided in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: New submission on its own MCP path: prepare a logo brief, generate logo concepts in the linked ManyMotions account and follow them to the images.
